name: tugite
description: Use impl-lead, plan-agent, plan-interactive, and review-refine with internal skills, Work Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors while the parent Codex agent owns planning, QA, and final verification.

interface.shortDescription: Install agents and delegate with parent QA.
interface.longDescription: Codex skills for the public workflows impl-lead, plan-agent, plan-interactive, and review-refine, their internal skills, Work Unit workers, reviewers, and advisors. The parent Codex agent performs parent QA and keeps final quality responsibility.
defaultPrompt: Use $plan-agent to draft or refine a free-form planning artifact without starting implementation.
Use $plan-interactive to draft a human-directed planning artifact through gate and fixed review without starting implementation.
Use $review-refine to review an immutable artifact snapshot with bounded rounds and caller-owned acceptance evidence.
Use $impl-lead to run bounded Work Unit implementation loops with parent QA.
Use $install-custom-agents to check, install, or update the bundled custom agents.
